results.name: unit: a projection with provider ≠ MERCADO_PAGO → 422 purchase_invalid; Mercado Pago never called; nothing recorded
unit: environment ≠ test (production / live / qa) → 422 purchase_invalid
unit: currency ≠ ARS, amount 0 / negative / fractional / string → 422 purchase_invalid
unit: a DB projection of another purchase id / external reference → refused; the price is the DB snapshot (39900) and the MP call goes only to the Mercado Pago API origin
lab: commerce lab reachable (mp-stub up, torneos-payments answers)
HMAC valid + created purchase → 200; Preference created at the stub and recorded in the DB (preference_created, same id, same expiry now+30min)
price comes from the DB: unit_price == amount_snapshot, ARS, quantity 1; X-Idempotency-Key == purchase.id; bearer is the TEST token; metadata/external_reference bound
checkout URL host valid: https + mercadopago.com(.ar) exactly as the provider guard
preference_created → the existing Preference is reused (GET, no new POST), same id and DB expiry; DB untouched
bad signature / wrong secret → 401; nothing created
timestamp outside ±30 s (old / future / non-numeric) → 401; inside the window → accepted
nonce missing / empty → 401; a replayed nonce → 401
body altered after signing / path altered (signed for another path) → 401
request with Origin → 403; with Authorization bearer (even with a valid HMAC) → 403; nothing created
input is exactly { purchase_id: <uuid> }: invalid UUID, extra fields (price/org/season/user/provider/environment/urls), arrays, non-JSON → 400
purchase inexistent → 404
provider / environment incorrect in the DB (FAKE local / FAKE qa purchase) → 404: the payment service lookup never returns it; amount/currency invalid cannot exist (CHECK 23514)
status not payable (pending / approved / cancelled / expired preference) → 409; Mercado Pago not called
Preference conflict: another preference recorded while Mercado Pago answered → 409 preference_conflict, DB keeps the first; existing preference whose MP id differs → 502, DB untouched
malicious / look-alike checkout host, http scheme, missing init_point, foreign collector → 502 provider_response_invalid; nothing recorded (purchase stays created)
Mercado Pago 5xx on create → 503 provider_unavailable; purchase stays created; a retry succeeds with the same idempotency key
other methods / paths → 404 (no generic proxy, no CORS preflight)
responses carry no secrets: no token, webhook secret, internal secret, seller, DB URL, internal headers, raw provider response or payer data
